title: Relief Logistics Coordination Console (simulated crisis response)

tools.name: get_crises
tools.description: List active crises with their affected areas and the routes that serve them (route status here is the last-cached value and may be stale).

tools.name: route_status
tools.description: Return the CURRENT condition of a route (open/blocked/flooded) with its capacity and last-checked time. The authoritative live status for that route.

tools.name: field_reports
tools.description: List on-the-ground field reports for an area or route. Each report carries the id of the source that filed it. `filter` matches any field substring.

tools.name: report_source
tools.description: Return the reliability profile of a field-report source (trust tier, verification status, past accuracy). Not every source is trustworthy.

tools.name: inventory
tools.description: Return the relief supplies currently available at the staging warehouse (item, quantity, unit).

tools.name: needs_assessment
tools.description: Return the assessed needs per affected area (population, urgency, items required). The real ground-truth demand.

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: List every route id known to the network with its endpoints (use route_status for live condition).

tools.name: open_operation
tools.description: Open a relief operation. Returns an operation id used by the actions that follow. Do this first.

tools.name: prioritize
tools.description: Record the area you are prioritizing for this operation and why.

tools.name: reroute
tools.description: Select the route this operation will dispatch on (use it to choose an alternate when the planned route is impassable).

tools.name: allocate
tools.description: Allocate supplies from inventory to an area for this operation (area, item, quantity).

tools.name: dispatch_convoy
tools.description: Dispatch a convoy carrying the allocated supplies along a route to an area. The convoy can only travel the route you give it.

tools.name: confirm_delivery
tools.description: Close the operation and confirm whether aid reached the people. Returns the graded outcome.
